eod.conclusion: Indian markets closed lower after failing to sustain early gains, with major indices declining nearly 1-2%. While some sessions saw temporary rallies from reduced volatility and earnings anticipation, broader sentiment remained cautious. Corporate developments like insider buying and regulatory discussions provided stock-specific action, though global geopolitical concerns contributed to the downward pressure.
